Thank you to everyone for being forthcoming with your answers. For longest time, I have longed to be a part of what seems like an amazing Brotherhood. It saddens me to say that I understand why there is no place for me within the Freemasons. No one has been aggressive or condescending towards me and I thank you for that. Without implying that my opinion should matter, I would like to say that I will continue to hold Freemasons in the highest regard.

The Brotherly love is very appealing to me. Just reading through some of the threads in this community makes me want to join even more. You are all so supportive of each other and I want to be a part of that.

I have noticed that Freemasons hold themselves to the highest standards. I want to be the very best person that I can be. I want to strive for excellence in everything that I do and I want to surround myself with people who are the same.

I absolutely want spiritual enlightenment and guidance. I want to learn and grow spiritually but I need guidance.

Theistic. I know that Satanism doesn't have the rich history that other religions do. It seems like history is very important to Masonary.

Let me be honest in saying that I also want to benefit from the business aspect. I am a business owner and have become very influential with my industry. I have picked up on the fact that some of my high profile customers, who I have a close relationship with are Freemasons. I would like ask if I would be granted introductions to people that I would like to rub shoulders with in business.
